answer_1.quote: We utilize the dev and test sets of two open-domain QA benchmark datasets with golden answers, i.e., NaturalQuestions (NQ) and TriviaQA (TQA) ... to assemble our experimental datasets.
answer_1.outputs: short factual answer strings (entity or phrase)

answer_2.quote: We employ the exact match metric to evaluate the correctness of candidate answers derived from contexts, considering an answer correct if its normalized form matches any of the golden answers.
